title: madirewolf portfolio dataset
description: Single source of truth for Mohammad Abu Daqer's portfolio. Content only: all render/orbital configuration (distance, speed, size, phase, tilt, bump, shape, shader type, color) stays in the my_universe repo and is joined back by project id.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp stamped by build.py on every run. Held as null in the hand-authored file.

also_written.description: Alternate transliteration of the same name; passport/legal spelling.

id.description: Stable kebab-case join key. Never renamed; presentation.ts in my_universe joins orbital config to this id.

lane_blurbs.description: One line per lane, emphasising that lane's angle. Keys must be a subset of `lanes`.

period.description: Omitted when no source file carries a verifiable date range.

metrics.description: Measured values only, traceable to PROJECT_INVENTORY.md. Omitted entirely when nothing was measured.

links.description: Restricted work never carries a repo link.

dev.description: How this project runs locally. Read by launcher/orrery.py, which starts, stops and watches every project that carries this block; a project without one is simply not launchable. PORTABLE FIELDS ONLY — this repository is public, so the block names a directory and a command and nothing else. The machine-specific root that `dir` hangs off is resolved at runtime from the ORRERY_ROOT environment variable, then launcher/launcher.local.json (git-ignored), then the hub's parent directory. A block carrying neither port_env nor port_arg describes a project that cannot be moved off its port; when that port is busy the launcher says who holds it instead of guessing.

dir.description: Directory NAME relative to the resolved projects root. Never an absolute path, a drive letter, or a .. segment: a machine path committed here would leak the author's filesystem layout to everyone reading the repository.

command.description: The dev server command, e.g. "npm run dev". Split on whitespace and run without a shell, so no pipes, redirects, or chained commands.

port.description: The port the server listens on by default. Also how the launcher tells 'starting' from 'running', and how it detects the collisions between the projects that all default to the same port.

url.description: The URL to open in a browser. Must be http(s) on localhost or 127.0.0.1; the launcher refuses to open anything else. Its port is rewritten when the project had to start on a different one.

kind.description: What the project runs on. Labelling only — `command` is authoritative.

ready_pattern.description: Optional regular expression over the server's stdout meaning 'it is up'. The launcher also probes the port, so this is a faster signal rather than the only one.

port_env.description: Environment variable that sets the port, e.g. "PORT". Present only when the project actually reads it.

port_arg.description: Command-line flag that sets the port, e.g. "--port". For an npm or pnpm script the launcher inserts the -- separator itself.

requires.description: One line naming a prerequisite the launcher cannot provide (a database, an install step). Shown to the user, never executed.
